A {{Convert|6|ft|4|in|adj=on}} [[combo guard]], he played [[college basketball]] for the [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State Wolfpack]], receiving all-[[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) honors in 2023. He was signed as an [[undrafted free agent]] on June 23, 2023. ==High school career== Smith attended Farmville Central High School in [[Farmville, North Carolina]].{{cite web|first=Chapel|last=Fowler|title=N.C. State commit Terquavion Smith ends his high school career with a near-triple double and a third state title|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2021/03/07/terquavion-smith-farmville-central-state-championship-nc-state-wolfpack/4616574001/|website=FayObserver.com|date=March 7, 2021|access-date=October 5, 2022}} As a senior, he averaged 25.6 points, six rebounds, 5.8 assists and 3.2 steals per game to lead Farmville Central to a perfect record. He was named the [[Gatorade Basketball Player of the Year]] for North Carolina.{{cite web|title=Farmville Central G Terquavion Smith named NC Gatorade Player of the Year|url=https://www.highschoolot.com/farmville-central-g-terquavion-smith-named-nc-gatorade-player-of-the-year/19710750/|website=HighSchoolOT.com|date=June 4, 2021|access-date=October 5, 2022}} He committed to [[NC State University]] to play [[college basketball]].{{cite web|first=Chapel|last=Fowler|title=Farmville Central, N.C. State commit Terquavion Smith land on SC Top 10 with between-the-legs alley-oop|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/high-school/basketball/2021/03/03/farmville-central-alley-oop-dunk-sportscenter-top-10-terquavion-smith/6901203002/|website=FayObserver.com|date=March 3, 2021|access-date=October 5, 2022}} ==College career== As a freshman at NC State, Smith started 25 of 32 games and averaged 16.3 points, 4.1 rebounds, and 2.1 assists per game.{{cite web |last=Pope |first=Jonas IV |date=June 16, 2022 |title=After flirting with NBA, Terquavion Smith looking forward to new role with NC State |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/nc-state/article262515052.html |access-date=October 9, 2023 |work=The News&Observer}}{{cite web |last=Pope |first=Jonas IV |date=January 26, 2022 |title=Just getting started, NC State guard Terquavion Smith already thriving on ACC Stage |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/nc-state/article257684373.html |access-date=October 9, 2023 |work=The News&Observer}} He hit 96 three-pointers which were the fourth most by a freshman in [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] history.{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=May 31, 2022 |title=Projected 1st-rounder Smith returns to NC State |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/34013617 |access-date=October 5, 2022 |website=ESPN.com}} He originally entered the [[2022 NBA draft]]; however, he withdrew his name and returned to NC State for his sophomore year.{{cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=April 12, 2022 |title=NC State standout freshman Smith entering draft |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33723776 |access-date=October 5, 2022 |website=ESPN.com}}{{cite web|first=Dan|last=Feldman|title=Terquavion Smith withdraws 2022|access-date=October 5, 2022}} ==Professional career== ===Philadelphia 76ers / Delaware Blue Coats (2023–2024)=== After going undrafted in the [[2023 NBA draft]], Smith signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]] on July 1, 2023.{{cite web|title=Ricky Council IV and Terquavion Smith Signed to Two-Way Contracts|url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/ricky-council-iv-terquavion-smith-sign-two-way-contracts|website=NBA.com|date=July 1, 2023|access-date=January 7, 2024}} On February 3, 2024, Smith scored 17 points in a game vs the [[2023–24 Brooklyn Nets season|Brooklyn Nets]].{{cite web|title=Brooklyn Nets vs Philadelphia 76ers Feb 3, 2024 Box Scores|url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022300698/box-score#box-score|website=NBA.com|access-date=February 5, 2024}} Smith made 16 total appearances for the 76ers during the [[2023–24 NBA season]], recording averages of 3.3 points, 0.3 rebounds, and 0.8 assists.{{Cite web|title=Terquavion Smith 2023-24 Stats per
